Hawthorn Whisper

Delicate white hawthorn blossoms with peachy-coral stamens dance across a warm, buttery yellow ground, accented with soft sage-green foliage. This gentle floral composition evokes the tender promise of spring blooms, bringing an airy, romantic lightness to any space. Perfect for creating a serene, uplifting atmosphere that feels both nostalgic and contemporary.
